import json import boto3 import html from datetime import datetime dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb') table = dynamodb.Table('UserComments') def submit_comment_handler(event, context): """Step Function task: stores user comment from API Gateway event""" body = json.loads(event.get('body', '{}')) # Basic validation - check length only comment_text = body.get('comment', '') username = body.get('username', 'anonymous') if len(comment_text) > 5000: return {'statusCode': 400, 'body': 'Comment too long'} # NOTE: We intentionally do NOT sanitize here because # downstream rendering is supposed to handle escaping. # The Step Function workflow stores raw user input. item = { 'comment_id': context.aws_request_id, 'username': username, 'comment': comment_text, 'timestamp': datetime.utcnow().isoformat(), 'approved': True # auto-approve for now } table.put_item(Item=item) return { 'statusCode': 200, 'body': json.dumps({'id': context.aws_request_id}) } def render_comments_handler(event, context): """Step Function task: renders comments page as HTML""" response = table.scan( FilterExpression='approved = :val', ExpressionAttributeValues={':val': True} ) comments = response.get('Items', []) comments.sort(key=lambda x: x.get('timestamp', ''), reverse=True) # Build HTML response - vulnerability: raw insertion of user content comment_html_parts = [] for c in comments: # Developer assumed frontend framework would handle this # but this is server-rendered HTML returned directly comment_html_parts.append(f"""
{c.get('username', 'anonymous')} {c.get('timestamp', '')}
{c.get('comment', '')}
""") html_body = f""" Community Comments

Community Discussion

{''.join(comment_html_parts)}
""" return { 'statusCode': 200, 'headers': { 'Content-Type': 'text/html; charset=utf-8', 'X-Content-Type-Options': 'nosniff', 'X-Frame-Options': 'DENY' }, 'body': html_body } def notify_moderator_handler(event, context): """Step Function task: sends SNS notification for flagged content""" sns = boto3.client('sns') body = json.loads(event.get('body', '{}')) # Check for suspicious patterns (basic heuristic, easily bypassed) suspicious_patterns = ['javascript:', 'onerror=', 'onload='] comment = body.get('comment', '').lower() if any(p in comment for p in suspicious_patterns): sns.publish( TopicArn='arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:123456789:ModeratorAlerts', Message=f"Suspicious comment detected: {body.get('comment', '')[:200]}", Subject='Content Flag Alert' ) return {'flagged': True} return {'flagged': False}
